nodes.title: SG-5 · Define frozen-contribution export for devion workseed handoff
nodes.body:
Context: Worldseed hands player contributions of a closed Round to devion project workseed. backend/internal/contribution has FileStore.ListByRound and ErrFrozen, and backend/internal/round writes snapshot.yaml (round, world, frozen_at, contributions with ids) on Close. No export exists. Desired behavior: a documented export with stable JSON (round id, contribution ids, authors, content, timestamps) containing only frozen contributions, independent of removed code. Why: removal of development automation must not break the handoff.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a round with a snapshot, When the export runs, Then JSON contains round id and for each frozen contribution id, author, content and created_at
- Given a round with no contributions, When exported, Then JSON has an empty contributions array, not null
- Given contributions on disk that are absent from the snapshot, When exported, Then they are excluded
- Given the export package, When compiled, Then it imports nothing from removed packages (worker, execution) and unit tests use mocked storage


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/contribution export code and its unit tests
- Out of scope: Calling devion
- Out of scope: Changing round package
- Out of scope: HTTP routes
- Preserve: Existing contribution Save/Get/List behavior
- Preserve: snapshot.yaml format


## Technical constraints
- Go module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/backend; contribution must not import internal/round (round depends on contribution)


## Definition of done
- Export documented, tested and go test ./internal/contribution passes


## Non-functional requirements
- Deterministic output order and field names


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Frozen export has a documented stable JSON format with only frozen contributions
nodes.body:
Add an Exporter in backend/internal/contribution that reads a round via an ExportSource interface (ListByRound, FrozenIDs) and returns an Export struct with stable JSON tags: version, world, round, contributions[{id, author, content, created_at}]. Package docs describe the format and lifecycle (only closed rounds with a snapshot are exportable).

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a source with 3 contributions of which 2 are frozen, When Export is called, Then output lists exactly the 2 frozen ones ordered by created_at then id
- Given a frozen set that is empty, When Export is called, Then contributions marshals to [] 
- Given a round not yet frozen, When Export is called, Then ErrNotFrozen is returned


## Scope
- In scope: export.go with Export types, Exporter, ErrNotFrozen, format doc comment
- Out of scope: Filesystem reading of snapshot
- Preserve: Contribution struct fields


## Technical constraints
- JSON field names fixed: version, world, round, contributions, id, author, content, created_at (RFC3339 UTC)


## Definition of done
- Format documented in package comment of export.go


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · FileStore supplies frozen contribution IDs from snapshot.yaml
nodes.body:
FileStore already implements ListByRound. Add FrozenIDs reading worlds/<world>/rounds/<round>/snapshot.yaml (the file round.writeSnapshot creates) and returning the contribution ids, reporting not-frozen when the file is absent.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a temp root with snapshot.yaml listing ids, When FrozenIDs is called, Then those ids are returned with frozen=true
- Given no snapshot.yaml, When FrozenIDs is called, Then frozen=false and no error
- Given unsafe world or round ids, When FrozenIDs is called, Then an error is returned


## Scope
- In scope: FileStore.FrozenIDs in a new file
- Out of scope: Writing snapshots
- Preserve: round.Snapshot format


## Technical constraints
- No import of internal/round; use a local minimal yaml struct


## Definition of done
- FileStore satisfies ExportSource via compile-time assertion


## Clarifying questions
- None
